text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] GPU OOM spike on cluster eu-west-2 (node group: infer-gpu-2). 6 containers restarted in last 3m during prefill phase for long-context requests. Pager triggered. :bangbang:

sre-oncall: I'm on it. Pulling logs and tracing which model/pool is getting hit.

mike: seeing repeated OOMs on model: long-context-7b-ctx32k, sequence length ~22k tokens prefill. Containers are hitting CUDA OOM during alloc for kv-cache.

ingrid: any CS impact?

cs-sam: yes — support flagged 5 customers with large-doc summarization errors, they got 502 / "container restart" responses. Low volume but high value. Customer IDs sent to pager DM.

eng-runtime: probable cause: prefill path allocating entire attention K/V for full sequence before streaming starts. For very long prompts + prefix caching disabled, that can spike GPU mem. Suggest quick mitigation: enable streaming-prefill-trim and fallback to coldmodel (cpu) for >16k tokens.

ops-joan: can we throttle or reject requests over the threshold until we have a safer allocator?

sre-oncall: quick mitigation plan: 1) add routing rule to move requests with prompt_token_count > 16000 to cpu-coldmodel pool 2) enable prefill-trim for the affected model 3) drain the hot node and restart pods. I'll run steps now.

mike: +1. Also enable per-request kv-cache allocation limit (hotfix flag) so alloc fails earlier and we can fallback instead of OOM-killing the container.

eng-runtime: patch (hotfix) pushed: runtime flag --max-prefill-alloc=12GB applied to long-context profile. That will trigger graceful fallback to streaming prefix trim.

sre-oncall: executing commands: 
```
# mark node cordon + drain
kubectl cordon node/infer-eu-2a-23
kubectl drain node/infer-eu-2a-23 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=30
# restart runtime on affected pods
kubectl rollout restart deploy/infra-infer-runtime -n inference
```

ops-joan: cordoned node and started drain. Pods are terminating and recreating on other nodes.

ingrid: applied routing rule in proxy: if header X-Prompt-Tokens > 16000 -> route to pool cpu-coldmodel, else normal. Verified in proxy logs.

cs-sam: notified impacted customers about temporary mitigation and potential slower responses on coldmodel. They appreciate the heads-up.

mike: after restart, I see reduced OOMs. Containers still rebooting on one rebuilt instance — looks like a flaky GPU driver on node infer-eu-2a-23. Kernel logs show repeated CUDA errors: 
```
[ 1234.567890] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 13, PID=2345: Ch 00000024, ilam 00000000, 00000000 00000000
```

eng-runtime: ack. Driver-level Xid 13 errors can cause CUDA to drop allocations. Opened infra ticket to repro and rotate that host out of pool. For now we've removed it via cordon.

sre-oncall: monitoring metrics: prefills > 16k routed away, OOM restarts down to 0 in last 4m. No new customer errors reported since mitigation.

ops-joan: node infer-eu-2a-23 is isolated; infra will rebuild it offline.

eng-runtime: follow-up actions: - Implement safe prefill allocator to allocate KV in streaming chunks - Add rate-limiter for very large prefill requests - Add model config option to enforce max effective context for hosted tier

mike: propose post-incident eval: run synthetic long-seq load tests with incremental prefill streaming to validate no regressions.

cs-sam: capture affected customer list for RM and escalations. Will coordinate outreach once we have RCA.

sre-oncall: current status: mitigation applied, customer-impact limited and informed, node drained and cordoned, hotfix applied. Moving to monitoring-only. If no regressions in 30m, we'll close pager.

ingrid: saving logs and configs for postmortem. I pushed a snippet to the incident runbook with the hotfix commands and the proxy rule.

incident-bot: Pager update: status changed to MONITORING by sre-oncall. Incident assigned to eng-runtime for RCA.

mike: thanks all. I'll schedule the follow-up postmortem and include load test items.

ops-joan: leaving note: consider adding an automated prefill token count metric to per-route telemetry so we can alert before OOM.

sre-oncall: agreed. I'll create the follow-up ticket and hand off to eng-runtime and infra for driver-level investigation.

cs-sam: customers responded: acceptable for now, will await RCA.

eng-runtime: assigning owner: @mike to lead RCA and patch.

mike: assigned. Closing handoff. :white_check_mark:
